designs.title: Pisa
designs.why: A clear, confident stamp you can read from 3 m away: perforated edge, double frame, header band, and a tower that leans into the open space so the empty sky feels intended. '3.97°' as the price is a smart joke (it's the tilt angle), and the tight figures balance the widely spaced serif PISA on one shared baseline. The postmark type (PISA ITALIA / 9·VIII 1173 / TOSCANA) is well set on its circle. Line weights hold up in one ink on both tees. Weak points: the brick ground strip is plain and cartoonish next to the detailed arcades. The wavy cancel lines start outside the frame and break up at the perforations, so they look stuck on rather than stamped across.
designs.fix: Make the cancellation one continuous stroke: run the wavy lines from the postmark ring across the frame and perforations in a single pass, with no breaks at the teeth, so the stamp reads as genuinely franked. Also give the brick ground strip the same fine detail as the tower.
